reviews.text: I have been using this product for a couple of weeks now, and the results are incredible. It feels very lightweight and absorbs quickly into the skin without leaving any greasy residue. My face feels deeply hydrated, plump, and has a healthy glow. It didn’t cause any breakouts, which is perfect for my sensitive skin. The packaging is great, and a little goes a long way. Highly recommend
reviews.zh: 我用咗呢款產品幾個星期，效果好驚人。佢質地好輕盈，吸收快，唔會留低任何油膩嘅殘留。我啲皮膚感覺深層補水、飽滿，睇落有健康嘅光澤。我嘅皮膚好敏感，但係佢冇引起任何爆痘，好適合我。包裝好靚，而且一點點已經夠。強烈推薦！

reviews.text:
I’ve been using the Dr. Melaxin Peel Shot Glow White Rice Toner, and I’ve really been enjoying it. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly into the skin without feeling sticky. It gives my skin an instant boost of hydration and leaves it looking fresh and healthy.

After using it consistently, my skin feels softer and smoother, and it layers well with the rest of my skincare routine. I also like that it helps prep my skin for serums and moisturizer without causing any irritation.

If you’re looking for a gentle, hydrating toner that leaves your skin feeling comfortable and gives it a natural glow, I’d definitely recommend trying this one.
reviews.zh:
我一直用緊 Dr. Melaxin Peel Shot Glow White Rice Toner，用得好享受。質地輕盈，吸收快，唔會黏手。用完即刻令皮膚補充咗水分，睇落新鮮又健康。

持續用咗之後，皮膚摸落更軟滑、更順，同其他護膚步驟配搭得好好。我仲鍾意佢幫皮膚為精華同保濕霜做好準備，而且唔會令皮膚不適。

如果你想搵一款温和、補水嘅爽膚水，用完皮膚感覺舒服，又有自然光澤，我一定會推薦你試吓呢款。

reviews.text: This toner completely exceeded my expectationS,I honestly fell in love with it from the first few uses. The texture is so refreshing, and it leaves my skin feeling deeply hydrated, soft, and incredibly smooth. My complexion looked brighter and healthier over time, and my skin just seemed to glow after every application. It's one of those products that makes you look forward to doing your skincare routine. Without a doubt, this has become one of my favorite toners, and I'll definitely be purchasing it myself once I run out.
reviews.zh: 呢款爽膚水完全超出我嘅期望，我頭幾次用就真係愛上咗。質地好清新，用完皮膚深層補水、柔軟，摸落超級順滑。用得耐啲，膚色變得更光亮、更健康，每次用完皮膚都好似有光澤。佢係嗰類令你期待做護膚嘅產品。毫無疑問，呢款已經成為我最鍾意嘅爽膚水之一，用完咗我一定會自己買。

reviews.text: The Dr. Melaxin Peel Shot Glow White Rice Toner is an excellent toner. It leaves my skin feeling refreshed, smooth, and well-hydrated after each use. The formula helps gently refine the skin while enhancing its natural glow, making my complexion look brighter and more even. It absorbs nicely without feeling sticky or heavy, and it layers well with the rest of my skincare routine. My skin feels soft, balanced, and nourished every time I use it. This toner is a great choice for anyone looking to boost radiance while keeping their skin comfortable and healthy-looking.
reviews.zh: Dr. Melaxin Peel Shot Glow White Rice Toner 係一款好出色嘅爽膚水。每次用完，皮膚都感覺清新、順滑、水潤。配方可以温和地令皮膚更細緻，同時提升天然光澤，令膚色睇落更光亮、更均勻。吸收得好好，唔會黏或者厚重，同其他護膚步驟配搭得好好。每次用完皮膚都軟滑、平衡、滋潤。呢款爽膚水好適合想提升光采，又想皮膚保持舒服、健康嘅人。

reviews.text: This Dr. Melaxin Peel Shot Toner gently exfoliated without leaving my skin tight or irritated. It helped smooth texture and boost radiance, making my complexion look fresher with regular use. A great toner if you want mild chemical exfoliation in your routine. I am using entire range and love it.
reviews.zh: 呢款 Dr. Melaxin Peel Shot Toner 好温和噉去除死皮，用完皮膚唔會繃緊，亦唔會刺激。經常用可以令皮膚紋理更滑，膚色睇落更清新。如果你想喺護膚中加入温和嘅化學去角質，呢款係好好嘅選擇。我而家用緊成個系列，好滿意。

reviews.text: I’ve just added this toner into my skincare routine and it’s so good! It’s so light and milky against my skin, not sticky at all. so it’s very good for those who use a few products in their routine. it’s very moisturising and refreshing against my skin leaving it feeling so hydrated. it’s a great step for brightening too.
reviews.zh: 我啱啱加咗呢款爽膚水落護膚步驟，真係好好！質地好輕、好似牛奶咁，貼住皮膚完全唔黏。所以好啱用幾款產品嘅人。好滋潤、清爽，用完皮膚感覺好水潤。提亮膚色方面都係好好嘅一步。

reviews.text: This toner is a solid addition to my combination skin care routine which brightens and add glow without super harsh exfoliants. This is more soothing and light weight ,also it might be a good option if you are sensitive to harsh exfoliants.It feels even better if we use it with a good moisturizer. Will be getting it again!
reviews.zh: 呢款爽膚水係我混合皮膚護膚步驟嘅好好補充，可以提亮膚色、增添光澤，又唔需要太強嘅去角質產品。佢更舒緩、質地輕，如果你對強效去角質產品敏感，呢款可能係好選擇。如果配合一款好嘅保濕霜一齊用，感覺更好。會再買！

reviews.text: The White Rice Peel Toner is a gentle yet effective exfoliating toner. It helps remove dead skin cells and leaves my skin feeling super smooth and fresh. I love that it doesn’t sting or dry out my skin like other exfoliants sometimes do. After using it a few times a week, I noticed my skin looking brighter and more refined. The rice extract gives it a nice nourishing feel, and it smells clean and subtle. It also preps my skin well for the rest of my skincare. I’ve seen fewer clogged pores and more glow overall. Great for dull or rough skin that needs a little boost!
reviews.zh: White Rice Peel Toner 係一款温和但有效嘅去角質爽膚水。佢幫助去除死皮，令皮膚感覺超級順滑清新。我最鍾意係佢唔似其他去角質產品咁，有時會刺痛或者搞到皮膚乾燥。每星期用幾次之後，我見到皮膚更亮、更細緻。米提取物令佢有種滋潤嘅感覺，而且味道乾淨淡雅。佢亦幫我皮膚為之後嘅護膚步驟做好準備。我見到堵塞嘅毛孔少咗，整體膚色更有光澤。對暗啞或粗糙、需要稍為提升嘅皮膚好好！
